guide.title: CCConfig · Node.js required
guide.heading: Node.js is required
guide.subtitle: CCConfig for macOS reuses your installed Node.js to run its local service. It does not bundle a runtime.
guide.installDownloadPrefix: Or download from the official site:
guide.installRequirement: Requires >= 18. After installing, fully quit and reopen CCConfig.

guide.pathComment1: # 1. Find the node binary in your terminal
guide.pathComment2: # 2. Restart the app with the environment variable

guide.troubleshootDesc: Startup logs are written to ~/.ccconfig/logs/sidecar.log, including every Node.js path that was tried.
